name: Roof light
summary: An opening in the roof that lets daylight fall into a room from above.
how: Make each opening 1% to 5% of the floor area under it.
Splay the sides of a deep opening, so that the light spreads before it reaches the floor.
Put the roof light over the place of use: a reading table, a stair or the centre of a hall.

origin.note: The dome of the Pantheon has an open oculus 8.9 m wide; it is the only source of light.

adoptions.via: Alvar Aalto cuts many round, deep roof lights into the reading room of the Viipuri Library.
